No image_gen. No code beyond the page and the two PIL images. No writes outside out/. No web. calls_used 0.
RETURN: receipt task_id "N5p-turnaround"; images []; files: every out/ file with sha256; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.
